photos.c: Right: Marjorie Jackson successfully takes the baton from Winsome Cripps in the sprint relay in the British Empire vs. U.S.A. match at White City, thus making up for her dropping it at Helsinki. The Australian team, completed by Verna Johnson and Shirley Strickland, defeated the Americans.
